verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI assistant built into the Stripe Dashboard that users can delegate tasks to. Stripe's AI capabilities here are aimed at external agents: an MCP server, agent plugins for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, and AI analysis that runs through an external agent. That is the opposite role from a built-in assistant. Workbench Shell is an in-browser command line, not an AI assistant, so it does not count either.
